scripts.script:
--========================================
-- CLICK TEST
-- QUADRADO MOVEL - PRETO E BRANCO
--========================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- EVITAR DUPLICAR A GUI
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("click TEST")
if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "click TEST"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui

-- BOTAO QUADRADO
local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Name = "ToggleButton"
toggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.6, 0)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
toggle.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 2
toggle.Text = "CLICK"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.TextSize = 16
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
toggle.Active = true
toggle.Parent = gui

-- MENU
local menu = Instance.new("Frame")
menu.Name = "MainMenu"
menu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 180)
menu.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -90)
menu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
menu.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
menu.BorderSizePixel = 2
menu.Visible = false
menu.Parent = gui

-- TITULO
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "click TEST"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = menu

-- BOTAO DE TESTE
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 45)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, 65)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.BorderSizePixel = 1
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.Text = "CLIQUE AQUI"
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 14
button.Parent = menu

local count = 0

button.Activated:Connect(function()
    count += 1
    button.Text = "CLIQUES: " .. count
end)

-- ARRASTAR O QUADRADO NO PC E CELULAR
local dragging = false
local pressPosition
local buttonStartPosition
local activeInput
local moved = false
local dragThreshold = 8

toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        return
    end

    dragging = true
    moved = false
    activeInput = input
    pressPosition = input.Position
    buttonStartPosition = toggle.Position
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then
        return
    end

    local validInput =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        and activeInput == input)

    if validInput then
        local delta = input.Position - pressPosition

        if delta.Magnitude > dragThreshold then
            moved = true
        end

        if moved then
            toggle.Position = UDim2.new(
                buttonStartPosition.X.Scale,
                buttonStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                buttonStartPosition.Y.Scale,
                buttonStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeInput
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = false
        activeInput = nil
    end
end)

-- ABRIR E FECHAR COM UM TOQUE/CLIQUE
local lastPressPosition
local wasDragging = false

toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not moved then
        menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
    end
end)

print("click TEST carregado!")

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Farm, Auto Catch, Cross, Dash, Gems + More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Huss Valley uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift. Its Runner tab automates safe-zone routing, revives downed allies, collects gems, avoids catchers with predictive threat vectors, and can override runner speed, dash, and emergency fallback behavior. The Catcher tab chases runners, prioritizes tackle or melee, predicts target movement, and includes smart targeting plus its own speed and turn controls. A Wheel tab automates spins with credit thresholds and cooldowns, and also offers manual spin and state refresh. Journey automation claims seasonal rewards on a loop, while Map Vote can automatically vote for Map 1, 2, or 3 and announce the choice. Utilities cover target-follow camera, goal/threat/hitbox visuals, a debug panel, and suppression of the game’s built-in AFK flag in the lobby. Settings handle notifications, anti-idle kick, rejoin, Discord copy, config saving, and a full unload that restores native walk speed and cleans up visuals and connections.
